checks: Open rows use the page surface, selection uses a solid surface, and compact completed rows stay selectable by keyboard.
Initial queue and real 1/3 prerequisite meter. Global ready count opens its actual queue while preserving the selected task.
Cross-project drill-down and return preserve original filters and restore source focus.
Multi-level edges and manual blocker; returning from a completed prerequisite reopens its source group.
Portfolio sorts by priority, project jump filters the queue, and empty results can be cleared.
All prerequisites met does not mark the task done. Missing records and cyclic back-edges cannot be opened.
Conflicting upstream completions are named, cannot unlock the dependent task, and can be reopened from the conflict block.
Reopening keeps the earlier result and the reopen reason; completing again leaves both results distinguishable in the record.
Releasing a manual block keeps its original reason and the recorded basis.
End-to-end: T-10 and T-11 enable T-12; T-12 and T-14 enable T-15. Viewing, cancellation and validation do not advance execution.
Releasing preserves the original phase and remaining prerequisites. Reopening is constrained by completed dependents.
Ten layouts, full long task title at 360px, first dependency action in the viewport, and exact mobile scroll restoration.
Theme toggle and same-content flat comparison remove the overlap and backdrop while preserving readable task context.
The task view overlaps the queue surface without covering controls; context stays fixed on follow, with reversible motion and reduced-motion support.
